scope: Independent source inspection and static source hash capture only; no emulator, engine execution, audio playback, UI operation, functional test or network transfer.
observations: Native cdaudio controls exist in retained C++ source but are not exported by the frozen generated runtime; no engine rebuild or unsupported runtime call was introduced.
Towers native music flag stays false; the independent one-track player does not change native effect/voice volume or the full audio context. Legacy Duel playlist branch remains retained.
Track route accepts only catalog-known IDs and serves exact bounded verified-pack byte slices; GET, HEAD, explicit/suffix/open byte ranges and unsatisfiable-range branches are present.
Native preference/session serialization and emitted lifecycle battle_session guard prevent stale outgoing iframe requests from controlling a new battle.
Native suspended state is included in metadata so initial background loading is gated; onPause/onResume/dispose and Web page visibility gate playback.
Audio play promises have generation/element ownership checks, Off pauses playback, disposal clears source and listeners, and playback failures are nonfatal.
Existing playback errors require explicit On retry; ordinary HUD refresh does not create a retry loop.
Popup uses shared touch-command binding and textContent for metadata, host and iframe outside-pointer handling, early Escape handling, and explicit Android Back menu priority.
Cached-pack inspection completion refreshes the current session so starting before verification finishes does not leave stale cached=false metadata.
Splash optional download uses the existing verified resumable store and inline progress/cancel/error path; first opt-in uses On only absent a prior preference and saved Off remains Off.
Splash mode row is hidden and launcher initializes Towers, while old Duel/music chooser implementations and native backend remain retained.
